recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Republic of the Marshall Islands. Mixed presidential-parliamentary system in free association with the us.
capital: Majuro · the capital is an atoll of 64 islands; governmental buildings are housed on three fused islands on the eastern side of the atoll: Djarrit, Uliga, and Delap
government: mixed presidential-parliamentary system in free association with the US
economy: upper middle-income Pacific island economy; US aid reliance; large public sector; coconut oil production as diesel fuel substitute; growing offshore banking locale; fishing rights seller; import-dependent GDP (PPP): $270.809 million (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Marshall Islands Police Department (includes a Sea Patrol Division)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
